cc:Work.dc:title: Training Dynamics
cc:Work.dc:description: All 27 recorded optimizer-group losses and actual learning rates for one epoch over 108 examples. 26 steps use a nonzero learning rate. Values are unsmoothed. Changing examples across groups mean the training trace does not establish convergence.
